# St. Tammany Parish Public Schools

> St. Tammany Parish Public Schools (STPPS) is a Louisiana public school district serving the Northshore region with comprehensive K-12 education, student support services, and community engagement.

STPPS operates multiple schools across St. Tammany Parish, Louisiana, including notable institutions like Covington High and Fontainebleau High. The district emphasizes academic excellence, student empowerment through the Leader in Me program, and comprehensive support services including mental health resources and special education.

- [School Board - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-district/school-board): School board information, meetings, documents, and governance details
- [Policies and Procedures - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-district/policies-and-procedures): School policies, handbooks, and procedures including civil rights and special education
- [2025 Building Futures, Securing Tomorrow Bond Renewal - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-district/bond2025): 2025 bond renewal information for school funding and capital improvements

- [School Performance - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-schools/school-performance): School performance metrics, graduation rates, and accountability data for STPPS

## Academic Programs & Instruction

- [Academics - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-schools/academics): Academic programs including early childhood, gifted, special education, and curriculum
- [Programs and Activities - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-schools/programs-and-activities): Student programs including virtual academy, STEM, career technical, and FFA
- [Leader in Me - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-schools/leader-in-me): Leader in Me program with 7 Habits and PBIS implementation for student empowerment
- [Athletics - St. Tammany Parish Public Schools](https://www.stpsb.org/our-district/departments-and-services/athletics): High school and junior high athletics programs, schedules, and live streaming
